first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person climbing the wall with their back to the camera, wearing a light-colored hood, dark brown upper-body clothing, a light-colored hanging cloth, and dark boots, with a long yellow-ochre cloth strip at the waist, and carrying a round shield and longbow on their back.

entities.name: gateway wall
entities.identification: A light pinkish-brown stone masonry wall, with a tall, narrow, light-colored wall surface in the center bearing a faded red vertical stripe, dark vertical members on both sides, and a reddish-brown crossbeam at the top.

entities.name: stone passageway
entities.identification: The walkable light pinkish-beige stone surface above and behind the gateway wall, excluding the parapet walls on both sides.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person lying horizontally across the passageway atop the wall, wearing a round brown helmet, a grayish-brown top, reddish-brown belt pieces, and dark lower-body clothing.

entities.name: cage brazier
entities.identification: A discernible dark cylindrical metal cage frame on the left side of the passageway, with horizontal bands and vertical rods.

entities.name: wooden stake fence
entities.identification: A densely arranged fence of slender grayish-brown vertical stakes at the far edge of the platform ahead, with uneven stake-top heights.

entities.name: stone building complex
entities.identification: The collection of light pinkish-brown and earthy-yellow stone buildings on the left and in the distance, excluding the roofed courtyard and the reddish-brown tower-wall complex.

entities.name: layered rock face
entities.identification: The reddish-brown to light earthy-yellow rock face on the right side of the image, with horizontal strata and irregular protrusions.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The bright light grayish-white to light yellowish-gray sky exposed above the buildings and rock face.

entities.name: vegetation
entities.identification: The visible collection of plants, consisting mainly of shrubs with slender branches and narrow leaves in the left foreground, together with distant green tree crowns.

entities.name: sandy ground
entities.identification: The light yellowish-brown sand and locally exposed rocky ground at a lower level outside the gateway wall.

entities.name: domed stone parapet wall
entities.identification: A thick light pinkish-beige stone parapet wall, with rounded-top blocks arranged along the top and a recessed frame and faded red patterns on the front.

entities.name: longbow
entities.identification: The slender yellowish-brown curved bow positioned diagonally behind Person A, with parts of the bow limbs extending from behind the shoulder and beside the waist.

entities.name: round shield
entities.identification: The dark greenish-black nearly circular shield resting against Person A's back, with light gold curling decoration on its surface.

entities.name: thin black cable
entities.identification: The thin dark cable spanning the upper part of the image, with its visible section curving slightly downward.
